channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Lakefront Luxury
channel.desc: Angela and Jay are searching for the ultimate lakefront upgrade, complete with enough space for their three boys and a foyer that stops you in your tracks; their tour kicks off with a modern masterpiece filled with glass, light, and a backyard that feels like a private resort; they step into a bold designer home where the two-story foyer, mirrored kitchen, and glamorous ensuite turn every corner into a moment; their final visit is a European-inspired escape with a sweeping staircase.
